note: Both sets capture the same core table values, geometry, and steel moduli with correct bindings and supporting quotes. Set B adds the correct background fact of steel's typical density (7,850 kg/m3) and a more informative condition on the effective density (paint, bolts, welds, flanges), while Set A keeps the stated 30% thickness increase and correctly attributes the linear taper to both radius and thickness. Set B's only defect is restating the 30% increase as a '1.3 ratio' value that does not appear in the quoted text, a minor derived value. The extra correct fact in B roughly offsets that small misstatement, so the sets are essentially equivalent.
